official_excerpts: Clear and transparent disclosure of the use of AI tools supports trust, reproducibility, and the integrity of the scientific record. Where AI tools have been used in ways that materially contribute to the research process, the preparation of the manuscript or the analysis, interpretation and presentation of results, authors must disclose this in a separate AI disclosure statement as part of the Acknowledgement section of their article. This ensures that its role is visible to readers, reviewers and downstream users.

The disclosure statement should identify the tool or model used, describe how it was used and explain the extent to which the authors verified, validated and critically reviewed the AI-assisted outputs. Where AI tools have been used as part of the research process rather than manuscript preparation, this use should be additionally described in detail in the Methods (and other relevant sections) of the main body of the article.

“During the preparation of this manuscript, the authors used [Tool Name, Version] to support [describe use]. The authors reviewed, validated and critically assessed all AI-assisted outputs and take full responsibility for the content of the manuscript.”
PLEASE NOTE: Where AI tools have been used for routine spelling, grammar and language editing that does not materially contribute to the manuscript a separate disclosure statement is not required.

Authors are encouraged, and may be required in fields where AI is central to the research method, to provide relevant prompts, prompt logs, model settings, outputs and validation materials as supplementary data where this is necessary to support transparency, reproducibility and assessment of the work. This requirement will be reviewed by IOP Publishing as community standards for AI-use disclosure and metadata develop.

Generate or modify reference lists – authors may use generative AI tools to support literature discovery, citation management, reference formatting and reference checking, but every cited source must be verified by the authors against the original source to confirm that it exists, is accurately represented, and is drawn upon and referenced in the main body of the manuscript.

interpretation.tool_or_model_identification_required_fo: OpenAI Codex identifies the established actual tool.
interpretation.version_status: Version appears in the template [Tool Name, Version], but the prose contains no separate explicit mandatory version clause. The page does not expressly waive unknown versions; journal acceptance of any statement remains an editorial decision.
interpretation.truthful_unknown_version_recommendation: Name OpenAI Codex; optionally state historical model versions could not be reliably established from the available records. Never infer a historical version from the current session.
interpretation.reason_routine_exception_does_not_apply: Existing records document analysis-code and verification-code development, source/literature checks, figure preparation and manuscript drafting/revision, exceeding routine spelling/grammar/language editing.

proposed_acknowledgement_wording: OpenAI Codex assisted source and literature checks, analysis-code and verification-code development, saved-result consistency checks, figure preparation, and manuscript drafting and language revision. Historical model versions could not be reliably established from the available records. The author personally reviewed and revised the final manuscript and takes full responsibility for its scientific content.
proposed_methods_wording: OpenAI Codex assisted analysis-code development and verification-code preparation. The computations use explicitly specified algorithms, and the archived validation reports document the numerical checks. Historical model versions could not be reliably established from the available records.
human_review_evidence_scope: The author reports personal review and revision of the current final manuscript, final approval and sole authorship. This report does not independently verify those human actions or imply personal verification of every original citation, code line, numerical output or institutional ethics decision.
additional_caution: IOP separately requires every cited source to be verified by authors against the original source. Generic final manuscript review should not be converted into an unreported assertion that all citations and research outputs were personally validated.
